description: Rothco’s Solar Lantern and Torchlight is the ultimate portable lighting solution for outdoor adventures and emergency preparedness. Featuring a 4.2V solar panel, this versatile survival device allows you to harness the power of the sun, providing eco-friendly energy for your lighting needs. The bright 3-watt 6-bulb LED lantern and 1-watt torchlight deliver powerful illumination with a 4-hour run time, ensuring you’re never left in the dark. Designed for convenience and durability, the lantern and torchlight combo is ideal for camping trips, emergency situations, or as a reliable addition to your bug-out bag. The 650mAh rechargeable battery with an indicator light ensures you always know when your device is ready for use. Compact, lightweight, and easy to carry, Rothco’s Solar Lantern and Torchlight is your go-to lighting companion for any situation.
